name: Does AKN Design Group offer designs for fire features that accommodate both wood and gas fuel sources?

mainEntity.name: Does AKN Design Group offer designs for fire features that accommodate both wood and gas fuel sources?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, AKN Design Group offers design solutions for outdoor fire features that can accommodate either wood-burning or natural gas/propane fuel sources, or in some cases, adaptable systems. The choice of fuel source is a key decision factor influenced by convenience, desired ambiance, and local regulations. While wood provides a traditional crackling fire experience, gas offers instant ignition and less cleanup. We discuss these practical tradeoffs during the design phase to determine the best fit for your lifestyle and preferences.
acceptedAnswer.description: AKN Design Group designs fire features for wood, natural gas, or propane fuel sources. The choice balances convenience, ambiance, and local regulations.
